verdict.rationale: GitLab's API/docs mention managing CI/CD processes across multiple projects and applying compliance controls with audit evidence per pipeline, implying some cross-project CI/CD oversight capability, but there's no direct evidence of a dedicated centralized CI/CD visibility dashboard, org-wide pipeline analytics, or reporting UI. Community evidence even highlights CI reliability issues (workers not running, deploy outages) rather than confirming visibility tooling. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a CI/CD analytics/dashboard feature, group-level pipeline status views, independent confirmation of cross-org visibility in practice.
